TOOLING BURST T4p — E1 fire projectile: painted primitives bound into the G1 grammar, arm A and arm B (Run C-5, E1; architecture 03- § 2.2 G1, § 2.3 alphabet, § 6 E1; charter § 4 E1). task_id "T4p".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b (G1 component), T4f (pierce/labels), T4h (pieces phase, all clauses), and the new row "T4p — E1 projectile arms" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (the skill spec — mechanics and bindings are LAW; the renderer never infers grammar from a name), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (G1 component: travel body + streak emission; the pieces phase; screen_px), export/vfx_material.gdshader, the painted primitives runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-prim-fire-head-01/fire_head_01_512.png and runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-prim-fire-streak-01/fire_streak_01_512.png (four-plane greyscale RGBA at 1:1 — quantise with oracle/peak_pieces.quantise or equivalent before use), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json (the impact you reuse), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

BUILD two kits from one spec, both registered in kits_v9.json (9th and 10th Tab entries), both with `screen_px: true`, the same fire palette, the same T4b events/seed/pierce, the same fire_burst_e0p_v2 impact (pieces phase, burst_v2 lap 3), the same cast flash/halo, the same floor light and victim tint — differing ONLY in how the TRAVEL is drawn:
- ARM B `fire_bolt_e1_B` (painted primitives composed at runtime): the head sprite (P01) leads, oriented along the travel direction (rotation = velocity angle; the painted head faces +x), the streak sprite (P02) trails from the head's rear socket with its length driven by speed (scale_x = clamp(speed / spec speed, 0.6, 1.4)), a subtle 2-frame flicker on the streak by band-step dissolve on the last band only (never on the head), both on the T4a material with LINEAR filtering, the streak's alpha eroding from the tail over 0.15 s when the bolt stops. No per-frame art.
- ARM A `fire_bolt_e1_A` (painted key states): the SAME two primitives are the "rest" state; the conductor later supplies up to two painted key states (e.g. a "stretched" and a "pulsed" travel drawing) at runs/C-5/artifacts/KS-fire-bolt/*.png — implement the swap: the travel alternates rest → key1 → rest → key2 on a hold schedule (3–4 frames each) from the kit's `key_states` list; until those paintings exist, arm A must still export using the rest state alone (an empty key_states list = arm B behaviour, byte-for-byte), so that A vs B is a fair comparison when the paintings land.
Speed 1040 px/s over 520 px (spec), release-locked aim, termination first contact or range, pierce 0; contact → the burst.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation for both arms (the spec's fields present; primitives quantised four-band); emitted G1 travel node tree contains head + streak with the orientation and scale rules; arm A with empty key_states exports byte-identically to arm B except the kit name; the eight existing kits byte-identical; headless import exit 0; a headless clock trace of one cast east at a dummy: contact within range, burst fired once, labels as T4f.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4p/acceptance.json; rendered = conductor's): the above; in-sandbox suite reds named.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4p/, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_A/, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/ and the two registration lines in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4p/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4p"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
